blocks.text: Cloverdale houses by price band, October 2026

31 houses sold in October against 193 listed. The price band with the most sales was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000, with 15 sold (48% of the month). Among bands with at least ten homes listed, the highest sales ratio was $1,000,001 to $1,250,000 at 24%.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Cloverdale?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 193 houses listed in Cloverdale and 31 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 16%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The October report gave $1,190,000 for houses in Cloverdale, against $1,212,500 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Cloverdale?
faq.a: The October report showed 22 days on market for houses in Cloverdale and a sale-to-list price ratio of 93%, against 19 days the month before.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Cloverdale?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Cloverdale?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
